_comment: Source of truth for the cli_commands[] portion of .vrooli/endpoints.json. Hand-maintained because the CLI is a separate Go module from the API; cross-module codegen would force one to import the other. Each entry mirrors a real subcommand registered in cli/domains/<dom>/register.go (or cli-core's StandardScenarioApp built-ins). Codegen verifies every cli_mapping.command in endpoints[] has a matching name here.

cli_commands.name: status
cli_commands.description: Check API and dependency health (auto-provided by cli-core's StandardScenarioApp)

cli_commands.name: targets register
cli_commands.description: Register (upsert) a backup target keyed by owner+name

cli_commands.name: targets deregister
cli_commands.description: Deregister a backup target by owner+name

cli_commands.name: targets get
cli_commands.description: Get a backup target by id

cli_commands.name: targets list
cli_commands.description: List backup targets (optionally filtered by owner)

cli_commands.name: destinations create
cli_commands.description: Create a destination (kopia repository)

cli_commands.name: destinations get
cli_commands.description: Get a destination by id

cli_commands.name: destinations list
cli_commands.description: List destinations

cli_commands.name: destinations update
cli_commands.description: Update a destination's cap and policy

cli_commands.name: destinations delete
cli_commands.description: Delete a destination (does not delete the repository)

cli_commands.name: destinations usage
cli_commands.description: Show a destination's usage vs cap

cli_commands.name: destinations readiness
cli_commands.description: Analyze a mounted filesystem location for backup readiness

cli_commands.name: destinations prepare-plan
cli_commands.description: Create a non-mutating destination-preparation plan

cli_commands.name: destinations prepare-execute
cli_commands.description: Dry-run or execute a destination-preparation plan after confirmation

cli_commands.name: discovery targets
cli_commands.description: List suggested targets worth protecting (well-known ~/.vrooli runtime state)

cli_commands.name: discovery destinations
cli_commands.description: List suggested destinations (mounted volumes / plugged-in drives) to back up to

cli_commands.name: discovery dismiss
cli_commands.description: Dismiss a suggestion permanently by id

cli_commands.name: coverage report
cli_commands.description: Show first-backup coverage: registered, recommended, sensitive, planned, backed-up, verified

cli_commands.name: coverage accept-defaults
cli_commands.description: Bulk-register non-sensitive discovered durable targets (sensitive require --include-sensitive)

cli_commands.name: plans create
cli_commands.description: Create a backup plan (targets×destinations, schedule, retention)

cli_commands.name: plans get
cli_commands.description: Get a plan by id

cli_commands.name: plans list
cli_commands.description: List plans

cli_commands.name: plans update
cli_commands.description: Update a plan

cli_commands.name: plans delete
cli_commands.description: Delete a plan

cli_commands.name: runs trigger
cli_commands.description: Trigger a backup run for a plan

cli_commands.name: runs get
cli_commands.description: Get a run by id

cli_commands.name: runs list
cli_commands.description: List runs (optionally by plan)

cli_commands.name: runs status
cli_commands.description: Show last-success per target

cli_commands.name: runs browse
cli_commands.description: Browse a snapshot's contents

cli_commands.name: runs stats
cli_commands.description: Show aggregate run performance metrics

cli_commands.name: safety ensure-destination
cli_commands.description: Ensure the Baseline Modes safety destination

cli_commands.name: safety backup-now
cli_commands.description: Back up a scenario's targets now

cli_commands.name: safety register-targets
cli_commands.description: Derive and register a scenario's backup targets

cli_commands.name: safety populate-shadow
cli_commands.description: Populate a shadow with a scenario's safety snapshots

cli_commands.name: restores restore
cli_commands.description: Restore a target's snapshot to a location

cli_commands.name: restores verify
cli_commands.description: Verify a snapshot (test-restore + checksum); the git-removal gate

cli_commands.name: restores get
cli_commands.description: Get a restore record by id

cli_commands.name: restores list
cli_commands.description: List restore records (optionally by target)

cli_commands.name: audits run
cli_commands.description: Run a generic snapshot audit: restore to scratch, capture live, compare generic inventory

cli_commands.name: audits get
cli_commands.description: Get a snapshot audit record by id

cli_commands.name: audits list
cli_commands.description: List snapshot audit records (optionally by target)
